# Duck DNS
> Free dynamic DNS service hosted on AWS for mapping changing IP addresses to stable Duck DNS subdomains.

Duck DNS provides simple dynamic DNS updates for personal domains and subdomains, with lightweight web, token, and integration-based update workflows. The site is minimal, so the most important resources are the homepage, update endpoint patterns, and policy pages.

## Core Service
- [Duck DNS Home](https://www.duckdns.org/): Main service homepage with account access, setup details, and dynamic DNS overview.
- [Duck DNS Root Domain](https://www.duckdns.org): Canonical root URL for the Duck DNS dynamic DNS service.
- [Dynamic DNS Update Endpoint](https://www.duckdns.org/update): Primary endpoint for updating domains with current IP address and configuration parameters.

## API and Update Usage
- [Update API](https://www.duckdns.org/update): HTTP-based API for setting IPv4, IPv6, TXT records, and clearing addresses.
- [Update API with Domain Parameter](https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}): Update request pattern targeting one or more Duck DNS domains.
- [Update API with Token Parameter](https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}&token={token}): Authenticated update request pattern using account token and domain name.
- [Update API with IP Parameter](https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}&token={token}&ip={ip}): Explicitly set the IPv4 address instead of auto-detecting client IP.
- [Update API with IPv6 Parameter](https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}&token={token}&ipv6={ipv6}): Set or update the IPv6 address for a Duck DNS domain.
- [Update API with TXT Parameter](https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}&token={token}&txt={value}): Set a TXT record value for verification or custom DNS workflows.
- [Update API with Clear Parameter](https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}&token={token}&clear=true): Clear existing address records during an update operation.

## Account and Authentication
- [Sign In with Google](https://www.duckdns.org/auth/google): Google-based authentication entry point for accessing Duck DNS accounts.
- [Sign In with GitHub](https://www.duckdns.org/auth/github): GitHub-based authentication entry point for managing Duck DNS domains.
- [Sign In with Reddit](https://www.duckdns.org/auth/reddit): Reddit-based authentication option for Duck DNS account access.
- [Sign In with Twitter/X](https://www.duckdns.org/auth/twitter): Social login endpoint for Twitter/X-based Duck DNS authentication.

## Domain Management
- [Domain Dashboard](https://www.duckdns.org/): Logged-in management area for creating and updating Duck DNS subdomains.
- [Subdomain Creation Workflow](https://www.duckdns.org/): Interface for registering free Duck DNS subdomains under duckdns.org.
- [Token-Based Domain Updates](https://www.duckdns.org/update): Programmatic domain management using account token and update requests.

## Integration Patterns
- [Cron-Based Updates](https://www.duckdns.org/update): Suitable endpoint for scheduled updates from Linux cron jobs or scripts.
- [Router and NAS Integrations](https://www.duckdns.org/update): Compatible with routers, NAS devices, and home server dynamic DNS clients.
- [Container and Homelab Updates](https://www.duckdns.org/update): Simple HTTP API works well for Docker, homelab, and self-hosted automation.
- [Certificate Verification TXT Updates](https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}&token={token}&txt={value}): TXT record support can assist with DNS-based verification workflows.

## Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://www.duckdns.org/tac.jsp): Terms governing use of the Duck DNS service.
- [Privacy Statement](https://www.duckdns.org/pp.jsp): Privacy policy describing handling of user and service data.
